cn-0D6J.title: Coverage: tripods with motion blur
cn-0D6J.summary: All official mainland coverage is made on a tripod, so images show motion blur and slightly saturated colours. Hong Kong and Macau have full Google car coverage.

cn-2kV6.title: Landmark: art museum, street with cafes
cn-2kV6.summary: A modern city street with several cafes and bars next to an art museum in the capital. In front of the museum is an uncanny statue.

cn-7ABL.title: Language: simplified Chinese characters
cn-7ABL.summary: Chinese characters are made of many strokes. Mainland signs use simplified characters, with far fewer strokes than the traditional ones used in Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau.

cn-9s1q.title: Landmark: museum car park with greenery
cn-9s1q.summary: The car park outside a big museum in Chengdu has a lot of greenery.

cn-CodW.title: Landmark: ancient town, straight street
cn-CodW.summary: The only ancient town you can pinpoint, recognised by its street running straight north to south.

cn-CygQ.title: Plate: blue with white text
cn-CygQ.summary: Licence plates are blue with white text.

cn-Fgo6.title: Landmark: boxy concrete museum
cn-Fgo6.summary: A museum in Shanghai with a boxy concrete main building.

cn-R4Q8.title: Coverage: small spots near east-coast cities
cn-R4Q8.summary: Coverage is a few small spots, mainly in or near big cities on the east coast. A lot of it is hidden, meaning it is not on Google Maps but can be reached via the Map Making App.

cn-TjfT.title: Landmark: palace-like museum, grey roofs
cn-TjfT.summary: A museum in Wuhan with palace-like architecture and grey roofs.

cn-V4ba.title: Landmark: white and grey angular museum
cn-V4ba.summary: A museum in Suzhou with symmetric, angular white and grey architecture.

cn-ZSAE.title: Landmark: rounded glass front, fountain
cn-ZSAE.summary: A silk museum in Hangzhou with a rounded glass facade and a fountain at the front.

cn-bsTm.title: Coverage: modern urban streets outside
cn-bsTm.summary: Outdoor coverage in modern city areas exists in a handful of big cities, such as Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Chengdu and Yangzhou.

cn-d3En.title: Landmark: beige rounded stone museum
cn-d3En.summary: A museum in Yangzhou, a beige rounded stone building.

cn-dosV.title: Coverage: ancient towns on the east coast
cn-dosV.summary: Old town coverage is found along the east coast, for example northeast of Xuzhou, in Yangzhou, west of Jiaxing and west of Zhangzhou.

cn-pTop.title: Landmark: massive palace complex
cn-pTop.summary: A huge palace in the centre of the capital, known as the Forbidden City.

cn-y76w.title: Coverage: inside museums
cn-y76w.summary: Many coverage spots are inside museums in many cities, most of them around the two biggest eastern cities.
